description:
Edelweiss spent her entire life yearning for her family’s love, only to be betrayed by the man she loved and her own half-sister, Rosemary. Their betrayal ultimately led her to a tragic and miserable death.

But fate grants Edelweiss a second chance. Reborn in the past, she vows to make those who ruined her life pay for every ounce of pain they caused her.

For her first act of revenge, Edelweiss sets her sights on Demian Lezenoel—the sole legitimate prince of the Imperial Family and the man her half-sister, Rosemary, desperately desires.

What begins as nothing more than a carefully calculated scheme for revenge soon takes an unexpected turn. As Edelweiss carries out her plan, she uncovers hidden truths about the people around her… and finds herself falling into a love she never intended to seek.
